title: Lead Installer Battery Storage and Solar PV Systems
description:
Lead Solar PV \& Energy Storage Systems Installer – Residential and Small Commercial

Nabu Energy – Bay Area, California

Pay: $34\.00–$40\.00 per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, job\-related skills, and other lawful job\-related factors

Job Type: Full\-time, nonexempt, hourly

Work Location: In person / field\-based throughout the Bay Area

Schedule: Generally approximately 32–40 hours per week. Schedules may include Monday–Friday and/or other days as project needs require. Actual hours and schedules may vary based on project availability, workload, weather, customer schedules, and other legitimate business needs. Hours are not guaranteed. Overtime may be available when authorized and will be paid in accordance with applicable California law.

About Nabu Energy

Nabu Energy is a growing renewable energy company serving the Bay Area and specializing in Solar PV (Photovoltaic) and Energy Storage Systems (ESS) for residential and small commercial customers.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Solar PV \& Energy Storage Systems Installer to perform and lead Solar PV and Energy Storage System installations. The ideal candidate takes pride in quality workmanship, safe installation practices, technical problem\-solving, and excellent customer service.

Position Summary

The Lead Solar PV \& Energy Storage Systems Installer is responsible for leading and performing residential and small commercial Solar PV and Energy Storage System installations in accordance with project plans, manufacturer specifications, applicable electrical and building requirements, safety standards, permitting requirements, and company procedures.

This position combines hands\-on installation responsibilities for Solar PV and Energy Storage Systems with crew leadership, electrical troubleshooting, quality control, documentation, system commissioning, and customer\-service responsibilities.

title: Wind Farm Technician I
description:
* **Standort(e):**
* Woodsboro, TX, US, 78393
  
  

**RWE Americas, LLC**
  

**To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent**


The **Wind Farm Technician I** ensures safe and effective execution of all operations and maintenance activities of one or more wind farms and related renewable energy facilities, adhering to established policies and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) protocols. This role is responsible for performing routine inspections, troubleshooting, and repairs of renewable energy systems and balance of plant equipment, while proactively identifying safety hazards and maintaining thorough documentation.


Working both independently and as part of a team, the Wind Farm Technician I supports continuous improvement initiatives, collaborates across departments, and assists with the implementation of technical solutions to enhance system performance. The position may also involve leading or mentoring junior staff, facilitating retrofit installations and complex repairs, and contributing to a culture of safety and operational excellence.


**Role Responsibilities**:


* Ensure all operation and maintenance activities are performed safely and in compliance with site\-specific policies, procedures, and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements
* Demonstrate proactive safety behaviors, including consistently reporting hazards and adhering to company values and safety protocols
* Lead installation, maintenance, repair, major component work, replacement, and troubleshooting, of renewable energy systems (including Solar, Wind, and BESS) as well as Balance of Plant (BoP) procedures such as substation and collection system maintenance
* Conduct acceptance and performance tests, inspections, and detailed reporting following planned maintenance or outages
* Lead and support large\-scale retrofit installations, maintenance projects, and troubleshooting of complex technical issues
